item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• New name: TogetherAudio is now EarShare.
  • Redesigned to feel at home on your Mac, with Liquid Glass on macOS 26.
  • New Bluetooth headphones are selected automatically.
  • A switch in the menu bar starts sharing in one click.
  • EarShare now updates itself, and checks for new versions once a day.
